contract: TASK-120 tombstone and delivery ledger (plan §4.4, S13, F16)
rules: Listed only for publications previously delivered to the same principal, on a channel still held at an adequate ceiling, that are no longer served.
Uniform entry: no cause, no time, no replacement link; a replaced lower-profile item appears as a tombstone while the report stays visible under its new id, never linked.
Feed page, detail and integration page record PublicationDelivery in the same transaction; a failed delivery insert fails the read closed with a uniform error and no partial body.
A principal whose grant was revoked gets 404 for the whole channel. The ledger is private evidence; retention deferred to M4.
